description: Mark Finchem joins Real America w/ Dan Ball to discuss the ongoing fiasco of the Maricopa County election, following Attorney General Brnovich's Election Integrity Unit requesting written answers from Maricopa County, and Kari Lake's strong condemnation of the rampant voter disenfranchisement on Election Day. In the interview, Mark Finchem and Dan Ball discuss the problems with printers, protocols, voter misdirection, and issues with tabulation equipment, and the tens of thousands of disenfranchised Arizona voters.
